items.source: An interface used by MongoTemplate for processing documents returned from a MongoDB query on a per-document basis. Implementations of this interface perform the actual work of processing each document but don't need to worry about exception handling. MongoExceptions will be caught and translated by the calling MongoTemplate An DocumentCallbackHandler is typically stateful: It keeps the result state within the object, to be available later for later inspection.
items.translation: 这是一个由MongoTemplate使用的接口，用于逐文档处理从 MongoDB 查询返回的文档。该接口的实现负责实际执行每个文档的处理工作，但无需担心异常处理。MongoException将由调用的 MongoTemplate 捕获并转换。DocumentCallbackHandler 通常是状态化的：它在对象内部维护结果状态，以便稍后进行检查。

items.source: Mark Pollack, Grame Rocher, Oliver Gierke, John Brisbin, Christoph Strobl
